news.title: Why popular airplanes are getting scrapped years early
news.description: Airplanes are getting dismantled for parts years ahead of schedule because engines and other components are in short supply.

news.title: Amgen says drug combo cuts risk of death by 58% in patients with aggressive lung cancer
news.description: A drug from Amgen could give patients with an aggressive form of lung cancer significantly more time to live when added to an immunotherapy from AstraZeneca.

news.title: Trump is pushing a massive AI buildout. His own voters are wary of what comes with it
news.description: A new CNBC survey finds broad voter opposition to nearby AI data centers, creating a political challenge for Trump and Republicans ahead of the midterm election.
